name: CAPABILITY GAP -> CREATE OR ACQUIRE
rule: NEED -> DETECT_GAP -> SEARCH_EXISTING_CAPABILITY -> COMPOSE -> CREATE_IF_NEEDED -> TEST -> RED_TEAM -> VALIDATE -> INTEGRATE_OR_REJECT
requirements: Apply to every AFAH/CEREBRON mission, colony, model, tool and R&D program.
Prefer reuse or composition before creating a new capability.
Create a new tool, specialist, colony, representation, test or interface only when a measured residual gap justifies it.
A created capability is a candidate, never proof of improvement.
Benchmark before/after; ablate; test transfer and regression.
Send claims through provenance, contradiction tracking and F72 Reality Gate.
Accepted capability enters controlled memory/learning through F59/F74; failed attempts enter the Failure Bank.
Respect resources, permissions, safety constraints and physical feasibility.
